Natural Hair Cancer Wigs – The Best and Most Comfortable Options

If you’re looking for natural-looking cancer wigs in India, human hair options are your best bet. Synthetic wigs just don’t provide the same realistic look and feel. With human hair, you get:

  • A natural appearance. Human hair wigs are made from real human hair, so they look completely natural and indistinguishable from your own hair. No one will be able to tell you’re wearing a wig.
  • Maximum comfort. Human hair is lightweight, breathable, and adjusts to your body temperature. It won’t make you feel overheated or itchy like synthetic fibers can.
  • Styling versatility. You can style a human hair wig just like your own hair. Curl it, straighten it, put it up in a ponytail – the options are endless. You get full control over your look and can change it up whenever you like.
  • Longevity. With proper care, a high-quality human hair wig can last over a year. Synthetic wigs typically only last 3 to 6 months before they start to deteriorate.

When shopping for human hair cancer wigs in India, look for options made of 100% Indian virgin Remy hair. This means the hair cuticles are intact and aligned in the same direction, resulting in a natural look and tangle-free experience. Remy hair is considered the highest quality and will provide the most natural appearance.

A human hair cancer wig may cost more upfront, but it’s worth the investment for a comfortable, natural-looking solution that will last. When facing hair loss from cancer treatment, a high-quality human hair wig can help restore confidence by giving you back a sense of normalcy and control over your appearance during a difficult time.

How to Care for Your Cancer Wig – Keeping It Looking Natural and Fresh

Wash Regularly

To keep your human hair cancer wig looking as natural as possible, it’s important to wash it regularly. We recommend washing your wig every 7 to 14 wears, or every 1 to 2 weeks. Use a mild shampoo and conditioner made for human hair wigs or extensions and lukewarm water. Gently massage the shampoo into the wig and rinse thoroughly with water to remove all traces of shampoo residue. Apply conditioner, comb through with a wide-tooth comb and leave on for 2-3 minutes. Rinse well.

Air Dry Away from Heat

After washing, gently blot out excess water with a towel and air dry your wig away from direct heat. Placing it on a wig stand or Styrofoam head will help it retain its shape as it dries. Avoid wringing out or twisting the hair which can cause damage. Let it air dry completely before wearing or styling. Using heat tools too often can dry out the hair and cause damage over time.

Style as Needed

Once dry, you may need to restyle your wig using heat tools like a blow dryer, flat iron or curling iron. Be very careful using hot tools, as human hair wigs are more prone to heat damage. Use a heat protectant spray and the proper heat setting for human hair. Styling the wig before wearing will help it look more natural. You can also trim the wig if needed to suit your face shape or style preference.

Store Properly

When not wearing your human hair cancer wig, store it on a wig stand or Styrofoam head in a cool spot away from direct sunlight. This will help the wig retain its shape and prevent excess frizzing or drying out. You can also place it in the bag it came with, but be sure to stuff the wig with tissue to hold its shape. Proper storage will help keep your wig looking its best for longer.

With regular care and maintenance, a high-quality human hair cancer wig can last 6-12 months before needing replacement. Following these best practices will ensure your wig provides comfort and confidence for as long as possible.

FAQ: Common Questions About Buying Cancer Wigs in India

Will the wig look natural?

Yes, human hair wigs provide the most natural look and feel. The hair is real human hair that has been carefully selected, cleaned and processed for use in wigs. When properly styled, a human hair wig is virtually indistinguishable from your natural hair. Synthetic wigs do not look natural and the quality is not good.

How long do human hair wigs last?

With proper care and maintenance, a human hair wig can last 6 months to 2 years. The exact lifespan will depend on the quality of the hair used and how often you wear the wig. Human hair wigs require more maintenance than synthetic wigs, but will last much longer and look more natural.

Do I need to style the wig?

Yes, human hair wigs require styling to achieve a natural look. The wig will come unstyled, so you will need to cut, color and style the wig yourself or with the help of a stylist. The good news is that human hair wigs can be styled just like your natural hair using heat tools and styling products. You can color, highlight, perm or straighten a human hair wig. Synthetic wigs cannot be heat styled and have a set style that cannot be changed.

How do I care for a human hair wig?

To keep your human hair wig looking its best:

  • Wash the wig every 4 to 6 wears or when it starts to look oily. Use a mild shampoo and conditioner made for human hair wigs.
  • Gently comb the wig with a wide-tooth comb after washing to remove tangles. Do not rub the hair with a towel, pat it gently instead.
  • Allow the wig to air dry away from direct heat. You can speed up drying time with a blow dryer on a cool setting.
  • Style as desired with heat tools and products once the wig is dry.
  • When not wearing the wig, store it on a wig stand in a cool spot away from direct sunlight.
  • Avoid excessive heat, friction and harsh hair products which can damage the hair.
  • Have the wig trimmed by a stylist every 4 to 6 weeks to maintain its shape and style.

With the proper care and maintenance, your human hair wig can provide a natural-looking solution for years to come. Let me know if you have any other questions!
